name: FILX DN404
fix_description: Add initialization protection to init(): either use OpenZeppelin initializer modifier, or add require(owner == address(0)) to ensure it can only be called once. Currently anyone can re-initialize and take ownership.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct exploit centered on an obvious initialization/access-control flaw: the attacker calls init on the victim proxy, withdraws the target token, then swaps it out on Uniswap. The PoC is well under 100 lines, uses only a couple of meaningful external interactions, and requires minimal protocol-specific reasoning beyond basic token liquidation.
